text:
maria: deploy-bot reported promotion failure for release v2.14.0 -> staging. artifact checksum mismatch on registry (artifact: redwood-inference/service:sha256:abc123). pipeline #5482 stopped, blocking canary promote.
deploy-bot: Promotion failed for artifact redwood-inference/service:sha256:abc123 -> staging. Reason: remote blob checksum mismatch (GET /blobs/sha256:abc123). Retry suggested.
ci-bot: re-ran verification step 5482-verify, same checksum mismatch. Logs: ```fetch blob: http 200 body truncated; calculated sha256 != expected```
devin: ugh. do we have a last-known-good image we can pin to for the promote?
maria: yes, last good is redwood-inference/service:sha256:9f7e2b (released 2026-03-16). proposal: pin canary to that and resume promote for other services, save this artifact investigation for post-promote.
ops-oncall: i can do the pin and redeploy. note: we should invalidate the registry cache if blob store is flaky, otherwise clients may pull corrupted layers.
jen: also need a short blurb in release notes that we rolled back the staging image and are re-running canary tests. will update notes once we confirm promote.
devin: what about CI flaky tests? the pipeline also hit an intermittent unit test (TestKVCacheEviction) in stage-integration. might be masking a real regression.
ci-bot: historical flake rate for TestKVCacheEviction: 4.2% past 30 days. Failing job id: 5482-stage-integ-5. Test trace: ```kv_cache_test.go:214: expected eviction but found retained key count 3```
sam: recommendation: pin to 9f7e2b, force rerun of the staging job with `--no-cache` to bypass potential CI cache corruption, and schedule full canary in next change window (02:00 UTC).
maria: ack. ops-oncall, can you pin and trigger the promote for other services excluding this artifact? also do the registry cache invalidate.
ops-oncall: on it. doing `registry.invalidate --blob sha256:abc123` then promoting pinned image for service. will create rollback PR for 2.14.0 artifact replacement.
deploy-bot: Promotion (partial) started: services A,B,C -> staging using pinned images. service D (this thread) remains pinned to sha256:9f7e2b.
devin: ci rerun started with `--no-cache` for stage-integration. watching logs.
ci-bot: rerun finished: stage-integration green on pinned image. TestKVCacheEviction passed 3/3 reruns.
maria: great. hold on final canary until ops confirms registry issue is resolved. jen, draft a note for the release doc saying: "staging temporarily using pinned artifact due to registry blob checksum mismatch; investigating corrupted upload; no customer impact expected."
jen: drafted and pushed to /docs/releases/v2.14.0.md (PR #672). will finalize after ops confirm.
ops-oncall: registry blob invalidation completed. storage team confirmed transient upload failure from mirror; they re-uploaded artifact with corrected checksums. still going to keep pinned until next full verification.
maria: decision: keep pinned for staging and do canary in next change window 02:00 UTC to be safe. unblock other promotions. mark release as held for artifact-fix in release board.
sam: scheduling note added to change window calendar and pinged infra-ops for extra monitoring. :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks everybody. re-open this thread if checksum mismatch resurfaces or tests start failing again.
